data.description: Media representing a computed tomography scan, including derivatives.
A set of pages in JPG format which can be displayed as a document in Arctos. DO NOT use this for things like PDFs, which are media type "text."
An image of any MIME type, including one embedded in an external application
An audio file of any MIME type, including one embedded in an external application
A video file of any MIME type, including one embedded in an external application
A text file of any MIME type, including one embedded in an external application
A mathematical coordinate-based representation of the surface of an object. Applicable to models created using methods such as photogrammetry, CT scanning, and laser surface scanning.
